baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted location 'in their wealth' places the known haqq inside holdings grammatically attributed to them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possession and liability overlap: the holder controls the stock, but a cognizable part of that stock is already another party's owned claim. Transfer therefore discharges an entitlement rather than creating a gift.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring and holding property supplies the possessed stock within which the claim is located.
A particular right owned by its claimant makes the embedded share an entitlement rather than discretionary generosity.
Knowledge as disclosure makes the internal claim cognizable instead of hidden in the total stock.

changed_reading.before: They voluntarily give a known amount from property that is wholly theirs.
changed_reading.after: Their property is already encumbered by a cognizable claim belonging to someone else, so payment recognizes prior entitlement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjective ma'lum directly qualifies haqq within the wealth phrase.
baseline_models.mechanism: A distinguishing mark and an exact-fit branch turn the right into a pre-identifiable slot within the larger holding. The allocation is separable, repeatable, and inspectable rather than an unbounded moral sentiment.

activation_trace.role: Property as an accumulated possession supplies the whole from which an internal allocation can be distinguished.
A fitted socket or exact middle supplies the image of a claim having its own precise seat inside the whole.
A distinguishing mark supplies the visibility by which the allocated right can be identified and followed.

changed_reading.before: Known means only that the duty is generally familiar.
changed_reading.after: Known means the right has a marked, exact place within the holding and can be identified before distribution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Haqq is located within wealth rather than described only at the moment it leaves the owner's hand.
baseline_models.mechanism: The protected-due branch makes the internal right a reserve that must survive the holder's competing uses. Its known mark lets the holder guard it as belonging to the claim rather than absorb it back into undifferentiated property.

activation_trace.role: Held wealth supplies the domain in which a reserve can remain under temporary control.
A due that must be protected supplies the custodial obligation to keep the claimant's share intact.
The identifying mark prevents the protected reserve from disappearing back into the general stock.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns an amount selected when giving occurs.
changed_reading.after: The verse concerns a claimant's reserve maintained inside wealth before it is paid out.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence wealth, haqq, and ma'lum joins possession to truth and disclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The internal claim tests whether the apparent ownership arrangement matches a firmer reality. Recognizing and making the right stand verifies the holder's relation to wealth; suppressing it leaves the visible total materially misleading.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the apparent ownership arrangement being tested.
Firm truth matching reality turns the right into a test of whether possession reflects what is actually due.
Making a right stand supplies the verifying act by which the hidden liability becomes effective.
Disclosure supplies the transition from latent claim to acknowledged reality.

changed_reading.before: The clause adds generosity to an otherwise settled account of ownership.
changed_reading.after: The clause tests and corrects the account of ownership by exposing a real claim already present within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering and enclosing create a stockpiling vessel, while anxious greed and withholding make that vessel self-sealing. The known internal right functions as a precommitted outlet that keeps part of accumulated wealth from obeying the holder's reactive grip.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed things into one stock supplies the accumulation stage of the mechanism.
Enclosing a thing in a vessel supplies the containment that can turn accumulation into hoarding.
Greedy, rapidly disturbed anxiety supplies the unstable disposition that tightens control over the stock.
Holding the hand back from giving supplies the blocked-outflow behavior the focus clause counters.
A binding due converts the outlet from optional generosity into a claim that resists withholding.
A visible mark lets the outgoing portion remain distinct while the rest is gathered and contained.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from gathering and enclosing in 70:18 to an anxious human disposition in 70:19 and explicit withholding in 70:21.
The exception beginning at 70:22 places the focus clause inside the counter-pattern to that sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accumulation, enclosure, anxious greed, withholding, and a marked due; I infer that the due is a precommitment device that preserves outflow, while the live alternative is that the list names virtues without a causal design.

changed_reading.before: The known right is a static entitlement located in wealth.
changed_reading.after: The known right is also an anti-hoarding release mechanism installed before fear or prosperity can close the owner's hand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Binding worship, continuity, and vigilant maintenance frame the wealth clause with a durable practice architecture. The known right is therefore read as a recurring discipline kept on schedule, not a sporadic response to emotion.

activation_trace.role: Prayer as binding worship supplies the disciplined practice framework immediately preceding the focus clause.
Stable continuity supplies cadence and persistence rather than a one-time act.
Adhering to and regularly maintaining an obligation supplies active upkeep at the list's closing prayer frame.
The binding due gives the recurring practice a non-discretionary object.
The identifying mark makes the recurring allocation stable across repetitions.

structural_cues: The focus clause follows prayer continuity in 70:23 within the same repeated relative-clause list.
Prayer preservation in 70:34 closes the list and creates a maintenance frame around the intervening duties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continuity and preservation around the focus clause; I infer that their temporal discipline carries into the known right, while the live alternative is that each listed trait has an independent rhythm.

changed_reading.before: The claim is known as an identifiable portion.
changed_reading.after: The claim is maintained as a recurring allocation whose regularity is part of what makes it known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse gives the claim two access conditions: voiced demand and deprivation in which the sought good has failed to arrive. A known right must therefore be operational for both visible request and need that does not successfully present itself.

activation_trace.role: Asking and requesting supplies the explicit claimant channel.
Deprivation and failure to obtain what is sought supply the claimant whose need is not converted into a successful request.
A particular owned right gives both recipient conditions standing independent of the holder's mood.
A mark that points toward its object makes the claim discoverable rather than dependent only on vocal demand.

structural_cues: Verse 70:25 directly completes the focus clause with two coordinated recipients.
Earlier asking in 70:1 and the collapse of asking between intimates in 70:10 make reliance on request alone structurally unstable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a requester and a deprived non-successor to the sought good; I infer two access channels for one right, while the live alternative is that both labels simply denote recipient classes without procedural implications.

changed_reading.before: Known means the holder knows how much to give when approached.
changed_reading.after: Known means the claim remains identifiable and actionable whether need speaks successfully or remains deprived and socially quiet.

context_deltas.mechanism: A wealth-giving right and a financial debt place the focus claim in a ledger of validation and settlement. Paying the known right verifies conduct now as a liability discharged ahead of the wider accounting named in the following trait.

activation_trace.role: A branch joining wealth-giving with a right supplies enacted verification through material payment.
Financial debt supplies the outstanding-liability model by which the embedded claim is settled.
A due obligation makes the internal right ledger-like rather than aspirational.
Known disclosure makes the liability available for recognition and settlement.

structural_cues: The recipient completion in 70:25 is followed immediately by validation of the day of din in 70:26.
Both clauses belong to the same repeated description of the excepted group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material-right branch and a financial-debt branch; I infer present payment as advance settlement and behavioral verification, while the live alternative is that din contributes only a future horizon without an accounting mechanism for the focus claim.

changed_reading.before: The right is a charitable allocation made from surplus.
changed_reading.after: The right is an acknowledged liability whose payment settles an account and verifies the holder's claimed order of values.

context_deltas.mechanism: Trust, covenantal preservation, and shepherd-like care convert possession into custody. The holder does not merely calculate another's right but watches over it through time as entrusted property embedded in the larger holding.

activation_trace.role: Security grounded in trust supplies the relational basis of entrusted custody.
Preserving and attending to something state after state supplies durable covenantal care.
The shepherd's protection of flock and dependents supplies an active stewardship model.
The protected due identifies what the holder must preserve within the entrusted stock.
The distinguishing mark lets custody track the protected right across time.

structural_cues: Trusts, covenant, and care occur together in 70:32 as another item in the same anaphoric list.
The possessive grammar of both wealth and trusts allows a repeated distinction between control and accountable custody.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trust, repeated preservation, and shepherding; I infer that this custodial structure governs the right held inside wealth, while the live alternative is that the later trust clause addresses unrelated deposits and promises only.

changed_reading.before: The owner protects a marked reserve until it is due.
changed_reading.after: The apparent owner acts as custodian of a claimant's marked reserve and owes it covenant-like, continuing care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Knowledge-bearing testimony and valuation make the known right externally answerable. Its mark is not only private recognition; it supports an amount and claim the holder can state, assess, and stand behind.

activation_trace.role: Statement grounded in knowledge supplies public articulation and evidentiary accountability.
Valuation and assessment supply a procedure for turning the marked claim into an answerable amount.
Establishing and making a right stand supplies the act that converts assessment into an effective claim.
A distinguishing sign makes the right traceable enough to be testified to and assessed.

structural_cues: The testimony clause in 70:33 directly follows the trust-and-covenant clause and remains within the same list as the focus.
The plural possessives make these practices accountable features of the described group rather than isolated events.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowledgeable testimony and a valuation branch; I infer an auditable wealth claim, while the live alternative is that testimony concerns a separate legal domain and does not specify publicity for the right.

changed_reading.before: The right is known inwardly by the wealth holder.
changed_reading.after: The right is sufficiently marked and assessed that the holder can answer for it before others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seeking beyond a limit and crossing it unjustly supply a boundary grammar. The known right marks an internal limit on possessive use: consuming or withholding the claimant's fitted share crosses a boundary even while the larger wealth remains under the holder's name.

activation_trace.role: Passing a limit through injustice supplies the violation produced when desire exceeds its legitimate domain.
Crossing a boundary and wronging another supplies the legal-spatial consequence of absorbing their claim.
The exact-fit branch gives the claimant's share a bounded seat inside the wealth.
The visible marker turns that seat into a limit the holder can recognize before crossing it.

structural_cues: Verse 70:31 explicitly closes the preceding permission structure by naming those who seek beyond it as transgressors.
The focus and boundary clauses are parallel traits in the same repeated syntactic series, though their immediate domains differ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limit-seeking and unjust boundary crossing; I infer that the marked right similarly bounds the use of wealth, while the live alternative is that the boundary mechanism remains confined to the immediately preceding sexual-ethics clause.

changed_reading.before: The right identifies what should be transferred.
changed_reading.after: The right also marks where the holder's legitimate use ends and another person's protected domain begins.

context_deltas.mechanism: Honor and coercive humiliation form opposite social outcomes. Framing assistance as the recipient's owned right rather than the giver's favor can transfer wealth without making dependence into abasement, preserving dignity on both sides of the claim.

activation_trace.role: Honor joined with praiseworthy generosity supplies the positive social register of the transfer.
Breakage under coercive humiliation supplies the degrading relation that entitlement framing can avoid.
A right owned by its claimant shifts status from dependent beneficiary to entitled party.
Acknowledged knowledge makes the recipient's standing explicit rather than socially concealed.

structural_cues: Honor is the stated outcome for the listed group in 70:35, while humiliation dominates the closing scene in 70:44.
The focus names the recipient relation as a right before either outcome is stated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies honor, generosity, and coercive humiliation; I infer that rights-based transfer interrupts a humiliating benefactor hierarchy, while the live alternative is that both status terms are exclusively eschatological outcomes.

changed_reading.before: The clause directs resources toward need.
changed_reading.after: The clause also regulates the social form of transfer so need is met through acknowledged standing rather than humiliating favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: A magnitude that reaches its limit and the separation of an allotted share give the marked focus-right quantitative procedure. The right can be read as a measured apportionment taken from the whole, not merely a socially recognized category.

activation_trace.role: An amount reaching its defining limit supplies calibration and a determinate magnitude.
Separating an allotted share from a whole supplies the operation that produces the claimant's portion.
Accumulated holdings supply the whole to be measured and apportioned.
The due obligation makes the apportioned quantity claim-bearing.
The distinguishing mark makes the measured share identifiable after division.

structural_cues: The opening context gives an immense day an explicit magnitude in 70:4.
The apportionment branch is activated from an oath form in 70:40, so its contribution is cross-branch rather than the local clause's surface sense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit magnitude and a branch for separating shares; I infer a quantitative allocation procedure for the known right, while the live alternative is that ma'lum denotes social recognizability without a fixed measure.

changed_reading.before: The right is marked as a distinct claim.
changed_reading.after: The right is produced by measuring a limit and apportioning a determinate share from the accumulated whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch for wealth leaving on a specified basis and a branch for a fixed base or amount turn the right from a static marked share into an executable outflow rule. Once holdings meet the fixed reference, the claimant's portion exits through a known channel.

activation_trace.role: Property leaving on a specified basis supplies a routed, rule-governed outflow rather than an undefined subtraction.
A thing's fixed base and amount supply the threshold or reference that activates the outflow.
The held stock supplies the property from which the specified outflow proceeds.
The claimant-owned right identifies the destination interest served by the outflow.
The distinguishing mark supplies the specified route and traceability of what exits.

structural_cues: Both activating roots occur together in 70:43, but their local source senses concern emergence and an erected object rather than finance.
The branchless rushing root in 70:43 supplies motion only as a structural cue and is not cited as branch evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a specified property outflow and a fixed-amount branch; I infer a threshold-to-disbursement arrow, while the live alternative is that both are distant analogies with no procedural force in the focus clause.

changed_reading.before: The known right is a fixed allocation held inside wealth.
changed_reading.after: The known right is a fixed-reference rule that routes a claimant's share out of wealth when the rule becomes applicable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads livestock maturity and seasonal completion branches into an otherwise general wealth clause. It remains anchored by the focus inventory's property branch, two due-condition branches, and the visible-mark branch. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory productive-capacity model, not as a recovered legal rate or a claim that all wealth is livestock.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The right is inside wealth and marked as known, allowing the mark to identify when the holding has reached a due condition.

activation_trace.role: Property accumulation, including livestock in the branch scope, supplies a productive holding capable of maturing.
An animal reaching the due age for carrying or use supplies a maturity point at which a claim ripens.
Fulfilled bodily or seasonal condition generalizes maturity from one age threshold to completed productive capacity.
A distinguishing mark supplies the observable condition by which ripeness becomes known.

changed_reading.before: The right is a static portion present whenever wealth is named.
changed_reading.after: The right can be imagined as ripening when a holding reaches a marked state of productive maturity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the activating branch comes from the context occurrence of ruh and must not be treated as the local gloss of that occurrence. It remains unusually well anchored because the branch literally contributes returning a right to its owner while the focus names an owned right inside wealth. Downstream prose should label the restoration mechanism as branch-triggered and exploratory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A claimant-owned haqq is located inside another party's holdings, creating something that can be returned rather than donated.

activation_trace.role: Returning a right to its owner supplies the restorative direction of transfer.
Possessed property supplies the temporary location from which restoration occurs.
The particular owned right supplies the claimant whose property status precedes transfer.
Cognizable knowledge lets the holder recognize what must be restored and to whom.

changed_reading.before: Giving moves some of the owner's property to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Payment restores to a claimant property that was already theirs in right while still lodged in the holder's wealth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant mapped target for the asking root and uses a smooth-flow branch rather than the source occurrence's ordinary request sense. It remains anchored by the requester completion, the wealth container, and the binding focus-right. Downstream prose should identify it as a split-root material analogy, not a lexical replacement for the requester.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus locates a due inside accumulated wealth, so a context-triggered flow image can model how that due exits the container.

activation_trace.role: Smooth flow from the non-dominant mapped root supplies an outlet image activated by the requester.
Accumulated property supplies the reservoir from which the marked due can flow.
The binding claim supplies the pressure and destination rule for release.
The marked allocation bounds the flow so it is directed rather than leakage.

changed_reading.before: The requester claims a fixed share from a holder's stock.
changed_reading.after: The request opens a designed, bounded outlet through which the already-due share flows from the stock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the rare spider term in the wealth root with a fitted-junction branch of haqq whose scope also carries a web expression. It remains focus-only and doubly branch-anchored, but the mechanism is wordplay-level rather than a secure semantic reading. Downstream prose should render it only as a contained image of interdependent ownership.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: All three focus lexemes can support a web image: the wealth-root spider term, a fitted seat for the right, and a mark that identifies the junction.

activation_trace.role: The rare spider term supplies the web's material image.
A fitted socket or exact junction, with a web expression in scope, supplies the right's structural seat.
A distinguishing mark makes the claim-bearing junction visible within the network.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is an aggregate owned by one holder with a claim subtracted from it.
changed_reading.after: Wealth can be imaged as an interdependent web whose marked junctions already seat other people's claims.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from voluntary giving to recognition of a claimant-owned liability already embedded in the holder's wealth.
The 70:18-21 sequence changed the known right into a precommitted outlet that counters accumulation, enclosure, anxious greed, and withholding.
The paired recipients in 70:25 made the right operational for both voiced request and deprivation that does not successfully ask.
Debt, trust, testimony, measure, and specified outflow changed a static moral claim into a maintained, answerable, and executable allocation.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activations were the return of a right to its owner from the ruh inventory, property leaving on a specified basis from the kharaja inventory, the non-dominant asking-root flow outlet, and the focus-only maturity and fitted-web images. Each changed the direction or material behavior of the right without replacing its anchor in wealth, haqq, and ma'lum.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not resolve whether ma'lum primarily marks a fixed quantity, public recognizability, a recurring schedule, or all three.

Custodial, boundary, dignity, apportionment, and outflow mechanisms transfer structure across neighboring list items or distant branch senses and therefore remain less secure than the direct entitlement and anti-withholding readings.
The maturity, split-root flow, ruh-return, and web readings are live branch activations, not claims that the rare branches are the ordinary lexical senses in their source ayat.
